## Independence disclosure

State your affiliation and any relationship to the VertiMosaic author/maintainer.

## Released version

Exact `vertimosaic` version installed from PyPI:

## Environment

Attach or link the complete `vertimosaic-reproduction-evidence/` directory generated by:

```bash
python -m pip install vertimosaic==<version>
vertimosaic-reproduce --expected-version <version> --output vertimosaic-reproduction-evidence
```

Please include `environment.json`, `installed-distributions.txt`, `formal_comparison.csv`,
`reproduction.json`, and `SHA256SUMS`.

## Result

Did the command complete without local source edits? If not, describe every deviation.

## Evidence publication

Provide a durable link to the evidence bundle if available. Maintainers will not label a
maintainer-generated run as independent external validation.
